specs.source_title: Bambu ASA Safety Data Sheet SDS20251127B01
specs.locator: p.4, 3 - Composition / Information on Ingredients › Component/Substance (row 1)
specs.test_condition: Main component, 95-99 % by wt, CAS 71512-90-8 (SDS section 3); the rest is an additive, 1-5 % by wt
specs.note: The SDS is the manufacturer's own (prepared by Shenzhen Tuozhu Technology Co., Ltd., product name "Bambu ASA"). In its layout the name cell wraps ("Acrylonitrile-styrene-acrylat" / "e (ASA)") and the row puts the CLP and ATE cells ("None None") before the % by wt, CAS and EC cells; the quote joins the wrapped name and leaves those cells out with an ellipsis. The TDS agrees in words (p.3, Other Physical and Chemical Properties: "Composition acrylonitrile - styrene - acrylate") and is headed "ASA" (p.1); the SDS row is cited because it states the abbreviation "ASA" itself, as the ASA CF file does. "ASA" is kept as the value so the material facet matches the other filaments (ABS, PC, PLA).

documents.title: Bambu Filament Technical Data Sheet V3.0: ASA
Bambu ASA Safety Data Sheet SDS20251127B01
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: ASA
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values; the registry has one key per scope, so the Z values (tensile 31 ± 4 MPa, elongation 4.6 ± 0.8 %, bending modulus 1650 ± 120 MPa, bending strength 40 ± 3 MPa, impact 4.9 ± 0.6 kJ/m²) are not stored. Density, melting, Vicat and HDT are raw-material properties from the TDS Physical Properties table and sit under material.* / thermal.*, apart from the printed-specimen mechanical.* rows.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2450 ± 270 MPa, Z 2120 ± 260 MPa), melt index 7.0 ± 0.8 g/10 min (260 °C, 2.16 kg), saturated water absorption rate 0.45 % (25 °C, 55% RH), crystallization temperature N/A, spool material PC + ABS (temperature resistance 90 °C), spool size 200 × 67 mm, printing and storage humidity < 20% RH (sealed, with desiccant), bed surface preparation glue, retraction length 0.8 - 1.4 mm, retraction speed 20 - 40 mm/s, max overhang angle ~ 70°, max bridging length ~ 40 mm, X1 Series heatbed drying 90 - 100 °C 12 h, suggested annealing 80 to 90 °C for 6 to 12 hours, odor, skin hazards, chemical stability, solubility, chemical resistance, flammability and combustion products.

The TDS recommended chamber temperature (p.1, "Chamber Temperature 45 - 60 °C") is not written to thermal.chamber_temp: that key is one number used for a printer's chamber capability (registry type number, template field chamber_temp_max), and this is a recommended range for printing the filament; no other filament file stores it.

SDS facts with no registry key are not stored: CLP "Not classified", conditions to avoid ("Avoid fire, elevated temperatures. direct sunlight.") and "Not hazardous goods" for sea (IMDG), DOT, road (ADR/RID) and air (ICAO-TI/IATA) transport. Its section 9 "No data available" for melting point and density does not override the TDS values. The SDS model "B01-xx" (p.2, section 1: "Model : B01-xx(xx stands for any suffix)") is not written to identity.model: the builder writes identity.model "ASA" from the reviewed identity map (§C.1), which a curated official_doc row would outrank and replace with a designation carrying a wildcard suffix (as in the ABS file).

Source disagreements kept for review: nozzle temperature (TDS 240 - 270 °C vs material-table wiki 240 - 280 °C); bed temperature (TDS 80 - 100 °C vs material-table wiki 90 - 100 °C); AMS HT drying time (drying wiki and material-table 8 h vs ABS / ASA / PC wiki 12 h); AMS lite (product sources "not compatible" vs the material-table wiki's combined AMS / AMS lite column "Compatible"). The product TDS values and the product-specific statements are kept.

Marketing prose proves no number: "Bambu ASA can remain in shape even at a temperature of 100°C" and the Highlights ("Extraordinary UV Resistance", "Exceptional Temperature Resistance", "High Impact Strength and Durability") are not stored as values.
not_published: the TDS states "N/A" for the glass transition temperature; filament length and hardness are stated in none of the documents searched.
Hex: all 6 colours of the hex table match a store Colour value by name (White, Gray, Red, Green, Blue, Black); the table names colours without codes. Its Green is #00A6A0 as published.
No in-the-box list: no official packing list exists for this filament (the store page has no What's in the Box section).
material.diameter_tolerance (± 0.03 mm) is the store page's own row (Product Features › bullet 6); the TDS gives no tolerance, so it is not restated here and not marked not_published.

The store page links a "Filament RoHS" certificate (https://store.bblcdn.com/94d2da6ca64b4d0e9c1e48faca32c89e.pdf) that was not cached and not read, so safety.certifications is neither curated nor marked not_published. The store-linked wiki page "Common print quality problems and solutions" (https://wiki.bambulab.com/en/knowledge-sharing/common-print-quality-problem) was not cached and not read.

The store has no Refill value for ASA (Type group: "Filament with spool" only), so no spool requirement is recorded. The store FAQ says the filament "is not food-grade" and may release styrene at printing temperatures; no registry key holds these.

Not stored although a registry key exists (one row per key, scope and region, or a type the key does not hold): heat deflection temperature 100 °C at 0.45 MPa (thermal.heat_deflection_temp keeps the 1.8 MPa row) and chamber temperature 45 - 60 °C (see the thermal.chamber_temp note).

Adjudication against the second extraction (59 field disagreements): locator wording (HDT, impact, drying, hex rows, the plate and printer relations), the store-page source URLs and target handles of the AMS, AMS lite, Cool Plate SuperTack and enclosed-printer relations, the "Enclosed printer" label and the family / part target kinds keep this file's form. material.type stays "ASA" from the SDS composition row, now quoted in the document's own words (the earlier quote joined a wrapped cell and was not found). thermal.heat_deflection_temp stays the TDS 1.8 MPa row (92 °C), as in every other filament file; the 0.45 MPa row (100 °C) that the second extraction took is noted. material.spool_type stays the store bullet (unverified, scoped to "Filament with spool"). thermal.chamber_temp (a range on a one-number printer key) and identity.model (the SDS wildcard "B01-xx") are not added. extrusion.supported_nozzle_diameters is added from the TDS Nozzle Size row; the nozzle relation stays. The second extraction's "Smooth PEI Plate" relation is not added: the material-table column "Bambu Smooth PEI / High-Temperature Plate" is the same plate (bambu-smooth-pei-plate) as this file's "High Temperature Plate" relation. material.net_weight is written as 1 kg, the TDS's own figure. Second adjudication pass (each one-file and different-value item re-read in the cached TDS, SDS, hex table, the three wiki pages and the store page): the decisions above stand; the P1P relation note now cites the reviewed compat-targets.json (no target, reason no_target_in_levonis_or_source) instead of the P0 draft's levonis_existing_model, the "A models" note no longer attributes the A1 mini to the a1_series id, and the HDT row notes that the store page and the ABS / ASA / PC wiki quote the TDS's 0.45 MPa row (100 ℃).

The store page's Parameters Comparison table (column ASA) agrees with the TDS on every figure it gives: composition "acrylonitrile - styrene - acrylate", impact strength XY 41.0 kJ/m², bending strength XY 65 MPa, bending modulus XY 1920 MPa, impact strength Z 4.9 kJ/m², HDT at 0.45 MPa 100 ℃ and saturated water absorption 0.45% (25 °C, 55% RH). Its sentence "Bambu ASA can remain in shape even at a temperature of 100°C" is marketing prose (see the marketing note).
